_doc: Camera profile: the product default for the Insta360 Link PTZ (v4l2 pan_absolute / tilt_absolute). Degrees come in, units are computed once here (units = deg x units_per_deg; one control step = one degree on both axes). pan_limit is the hardware's +/- pan range; the grabber wraps pan modulo 2 x pan_limit, so +pan_limit itself becomes -pan_limit and an aim stops one step inside it. tilt_min/tilt_max are the hardware tilt range. Override the path with RAIL_CAMERA_PROFILE. The User 2026-10-04, Init v2.
